name: Syan

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Masaba language' and 'Gwere language' articles (checked for mentions of Syan/Orusyan and prosody)

Segment inventory only (consonants, long/short vowels, two nasal vowels); no tones listed and nothing on stress/accent.
